parameters.name: Direction
parameters.description:
The traffic direction of the access control policy.

Valid values:

- **in**: Inbound traffic

- **out**: Outbound traffic

parameters.name: IpVersion
parameters.description:
The IP version for assets protected by Cloud Firewall.

Valid values:

- **4** (Default): IPv4

- **6**: IPv6

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the request and response.

Valid values:

- **zh** (Default): Chinese

- **en**: English

parameters.name: SourceIp
parameters.description: The source IP address of the request.
